target_customer: Millennial retail investors holding accounts at multiple brokerages
problem: Investors hold accounts across brokerages and lack one place to trade and get ETF-based portfolio ideas.
product_category: Consumer investing app and portfolio aggregator

founders.name: Alexander Kwan
prior_employers: Relativity Space (2nd employee, Head of Finance, Strategy and Business Operations)
founders.background_notes: Started career in banking, hedge funds and PE per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Brokerage account linking and trading across providers is integration-heavy and regulated for a team of three.

defensibility.rationale: Brokerage aggregation depends on third-party APIs; ETF suggestions were easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Acquired per YC directory; acquirer and date not found.

market_need_then: Retail investing boomed in 2020-2021 and users held multiple accounts; no source with specific demand data was found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Later branding calls it an investing copilot (per search snippet)

brand_strength.rationale: A three-letter name that collides with many other uses (TAI) and no brand coverage found.

outcome_analysis: TAI was a three-person Winter 2022 investing app by a founder from Relativity Space and SpaceX. The YC directory lists it as acquired but no acquirer, date or price is public in sources found, and the only funding figure is an aggregator estimate of about $500K. Whether this was a real exit or a soft landing cannot be determined.
notes: Acquirer, date and price not found (Axios fintech deals page was 403). VCBacked lists about $500K pre-seed, last round March 2022; single aggregator, unverified, not recorded as a round. No dated competitors near Jan 2022 found (Front's Trading Across Brokerages launched June 2022, after the batch, and is not listed). No website listed for TAI. Name origin not found. Completeness pass: the pre-seed of about 500K USD in 2022-03 is recorded from VCBacked alone; CB Insights dates a pre-seed to 2022-01. No press release or filing found.
